engineeringOverlay.scope: Fixed-unit scalar conversion through the exact existing v1 factor table. Decimal input is represented by binary64; physical applicability, source review and complete canonical acceptance are separate. The caller must refuse nonzero input rounded to zero by a linear conversion. Explicit U.S. liquid gallon/quart codes; no imperial gallon or ingredient-density conversion.
limitations: Offered unit codes only; formal canonical and source applicability remain subject to competent acceptance.

OWN-427 approves this product scope only; source applicability, competent QA and certification remain separate. Historical v1 is unchanged.
limitations: Offered unit codes only; formal canonical and source applicability remain subject to competent acceptance.
